D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Chordal/GainPo.signature: theorem IsChordal.exists_approximate_gain_potential [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.IsChordal) (g : V → V → H) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hrev : ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → g j i = (g i j)⁻¹) (htri : ∀ i j k, G.Adj i j → G.Adj j k → G.Adj i k → Dist.dist (g i j * g j k) (g i k) ≤ ε) : ∃ φ : V → H, ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → Dist.dist (g i j) ((φ i)⁻¹ * φ j) ≤ ((Nat.card V - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε
